Package com.epitech.depthdiablo.entity.projectile

Class Fireball

java.lang.Object
com.epitech.depthdiablo.entity.Entity
com.epitech.depthdiablo.entity.projectile.Projectile
com.epitech.depthdiablo.entity.projectile.Fireball
All Implemented Interfaces:
Rewindable, Collidable, Updatable
public final class Fireball extends Projectile
The shot of the Dark Mage (GDD 1.3.1): it burns the first character it hurts, then stops. A hit that lands nothing, on a character rolling for example, does not burn either.

  • Constructor Details

    • Fireball

      public Fireball(Aabb bodyBox, Character owner, float aimDegrees, float speed, int lifetimeTicks, String spriteId, DotSpec burn, World world)
      Creates a fireball. Its length along its flight is the width of its body box.
      Parameters:
      bodyBox - where it starts; must not be null
      owner - the character who cast it; the source of the burn
      aimDegrees - the direction it flies to, in degrees (0 = right, 90 = up)
      speed - how fast it flies, in pixels per second; above 0
      lifetimeTicks - how many ticks it flies before it is removed; above 0
      spriteId - the picture the renderer draws for it, pointing right
      burn - the burn it leaves on the character it hurts, read from the data files (Q93)
      world - the world it flies in
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if bodyBox, owner, spriteId, burn or world is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if the aim or the speed is not a finite number, the speed is 0 or less, the lifetime is 0 or less, or the sprite id is blank
